---
title: "How to contribute"
---

Use the [plain-language suggestion page](contributions/index.qmd). Readers submit a question, problem or proposed improvement. They are not expected to edit files or prepare a pull request.

## What makes a useful contribution

Describe the reader’s situation, the decision or failure mode, where the change belongs, the proposed improvement and any supporting evidence. An editor will check the source, scope and implications before deciding whether work should begin.

## Privacy and licensing

Do not contribute confidential, identifiable, restricted or security-sensitive material. Prose and reusable non-code content are accepted under CC BY 4.0; code, configuration and scripts are accepted under MIT. Contributors may request named, organisational, pseudonymous or no public credit.

## Editorial outcomes

Haresh may approve, defer, request evidence, mark as a duplicate, classify as a local adaptation, decline or close a suggestion as out of scope. Only an approved issue can become agent work. The agent prepares a pull request, which Haresh reviews before anything is merged or published.
